Diluted earnings per share: Loss per share $0.07 for Q2 2026 vs. $0.05 loss per share in the year‑ago quarter.

Clinical development: Advanced mizagliflozin toward post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) and gastroparesis with planning for an EMERGE Phase 2b and increased PBH trial spending.
